session.fingerprint_note: working tree with every experimental term off reproduces the rated-v1 fingerprint exactly

experiments.hypothesis: the material term pays almost the full tapered value for a single-unit surplus in eight low-material families where it rarely converts; removing a fixed fraction of that nominal surplus removes the false wins without damaging the genuine ones
experiments.motivation: false-win audit: 429 of the audited drawn positions were scored >= +150, and the decomposition attributed the score to the material term to the centipawn
experiments.implementation: cs_drawish.py, term low_material, stage post, flag CS_EVAL_LOW_MATERIAL, default off
experiments.parameters: remove 3/4 of the surplus in families A and C, 1/2 in family B, computed from the evaluator's own tapered piece values
experiments.diagnostic_population: 983 oracle-labelled audit positions in eight families
experiments.affected_population: 0.9% of evaluations over 200 retained games; 2.5% of the calibration set
experiments.gate0: pass (40 semantic tests, fast == reference on 500 random-play positions, 4000 random placements and all 983 audit positions)
experiments.gate1: pass (421 of 429 false wins removed, 0 of 112 genuine wins and 0 of 6 strategic wins under +100, 0 moves changed on blind-win, conversion, tactics and 240 suites)

targeted_match.verdict: 2 genuine regressions, 2 correct losses of objectively lost positions, 0 improvements

experiments.decision: KEEP FOR MORE TESTING, not promoted
experiments.reason: correct on its evaluation target and never shown to win a game; the Gate 2 instrument has one informative cluster of a hundred
